sourceBoundary.selection: At least three of areas 2–7 in a school year; biological/chemical balance; area 1 where appropriate. Source expectations/contents are suggestions, not all annual mandatory duties.
sourceBoundary.doesNotGrant: No nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty, runtime selection implementation, source-mapping approval or final-exam prerequisite clearance.

goalReviews.titleEn: Analyse mixture composition qualitatively and quantitatively
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann geeignete Analyseverfahren auswählen, sicher durchführen und dokumentieren, um die Bestandteile eines Stoffgemisches und ihre Mengenanteile mit nachvollziehbarer Stoffbilanz und Aussagegrenzen zu bestimmen.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can select, safely perform and document suitable analyses to determine the components and quantities in a mixture, with a transparent material balance and limits of inference.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB3: qualitative and quantitative mixture composition with safe documented analysis.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Component discrimination and quantities within a transparent balance form one analytical outcome. Both languages retain selection, actual performance, documentation and inference limits.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Iron/NaCl/sand provides complete prospective analysis; the NaCl/sucrose variant keeps unseparated shares unresolved. Recovery is not purity or identity of missing mass.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Generic preparation/analysis/evaluation imagery is orientation only. It gives no measured amounts or identity proof. Data-validity, documentation and safety prerequisites fit the analytical claim.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann für einen begründeten Kandidatenraum unterscheidende Analyseverfahren auswählen, sicher durchführen und dokumentieren, um eine unbekannte Reinstoffprobe anhand von Referenzen zu identifizieren und verbleibende Mehrdeutigkeit offenzulegen.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can select, safely perform and document discriminating analyses for a justified candidate set, identify an unknown pure-substance sample against references and disclose remaining ambiguity.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB3: choose and safely perform analyses to identify unknown pure substances.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: A justified candidate set, discriminating methods, references and disclosed ambiguity make identification assessable and equivalent in DE/EN.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Solubility/conductivity and the Na/K extension expose the need for another selective method after expanding the candidate set. The enclosed emission station is an explicit feasibility condition; no execution is claimed.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The shared analysis montage cannot identify an unknown or establish its purity. Current safety/data-validity foundations are distinct from the required identification performance.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann einen biotechnologischen Herstellungsweg mit geeigneten biologischen Kontrollen planen, sicher durchführen, aufarbeiten und dokumentieren sowie die erhaltene Präparation und die Grenzen des Produktnachweises fachlich begründen.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can plan a biotechnological production route with suitable biological controls, perform it safely, work it up and document it, explaining the preparation obtained and the limits of product identification.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB4: biotechnological production with safe documented preparation and work-up.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Production route, biological controls, obtained preparation and product-identification limits form a coherent practical outcome. English work it up preserves aufarbeiten.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Active/inactive yeast and the starch variant support a prospective controlled manufacture/work-up assessment. Gas volume and filtration do not prove ethanol, gas identity or purity.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Matched active/inactive flasks and filtration with an unresolved dissolved mixture orient the learner. Actual original practical records remain necessary.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleEn: Prepare and work up substances chemically
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine chemische Präparation anhand von Reaktionsgleichung und Stoffmengen planen, sicher durchführen, aufarbeiten und dokumentieren sowie Produktmasse, Ausbeute und Reinheitsgrenzen begründet unterscheiden.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can plan a chemical preparation from its reaction equation and quantities, perform it safely, work it up and document it, distinguishing product mass, yield and limits of purity.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB4: chemical preparation, work-up, documented purity and yield considerations.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Reaction equation and quantities support practical planning; product mass, yield and purity limits are explicitly distinguished in equivalent DE/EN.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Calcium-carbonate batches and the explicitly referenced concentration change make the outcome assessable. Theoretical mass, gross mass yield and purity-corrected yield remain different statements.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Planning, collection/washing and an unquantified product question fit the scope. Equation/molar-mass prerequisites support the balance; the picture is not execution evidence.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleDe: Grundlegende Anforderungen von Lebewesen experimentell untersuchen
goalReviews.titleEn: Investigate basic requirements of organisms experimentally
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine prüfbare Hypothese zu einer grundlegenden Anforderung von Lebewesen durch einen kontrollierten Versuch sicher, art- und naturschutzgerecht untersuchen, eigene Bedingungen und Beobachtungen dokumentieren und die Schlussfolgerung auf die geprüften Organismen und Bedingungen begrenzen.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can investigate a testable hypothesis about a basic requirement of organisms through a safe, species- and nature-respecting controlled experiment, document original conditions and observations and limit conclusions to the organisms and conditions tested.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB6: hypothesis-led organism-requirements investigations with safety and species/nature protection.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Controlled investigation, original conditions/observations and bounded inference define one practical performance in equivalent DE/EN.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Dry/moist cress and new salinity conditions expose control and water-accounting decisions. Nominal start salinity is not continuously proven constant concentration or a universal plant threshold.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Bean germination is a schematic life-stage sequence; light is explicitly assigned to later growth. It is not a cress dataset or controlled investigation result.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleEn: Investigate factors affecting enzyme reactions experimentally
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine Hypothese zum Einfluss eines Außenfaktors auf eine Enzymreaktion durch einen kontrollierten Versuch sicher sowie art- und naturschutzgerecht prüfen, eigene Reaktionsbeobachtungen dokumentieren und Enzymwirkung, Störgrößen und Aussagegrenzen unterscheiden.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can test a hypothesis about an external factor affecting an enzyme reaction through a safe, species- and nature-respecting controlled experiment, document original reaction observations and distinguish enzyme action, confounders and limits of inference.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB6: investigate influences on enzyme reactions, with LB1 controlled-method/documentation context.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: The description requires a factor hypothesis, controlled original observations and discrimination of action, confounders and limits. Describing an optimum curve alone cannot satisfy it.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Cooled heat-pretreated crude extract and fresh extract-amount comparisons expose different factors. Ordinal bubbling cannot supply oxygen amounts, purified-enzyme kinetics or a universal optimum.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Different-enzyme pH curves are a model example rather than catalase measurements. The conceptual enzyme-factor prerequisite remains separate from the practical outcome.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleEn: Investigate organism stimulus responses with controls
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine Hypothese zu einer beobachtbaren Reizantwort von Lebewesen mit definiertem Reiz, geeigneter Scheinbehandlung und Messregel sicher, art- und naturschutzgerecht prüfen, eigene zeitbezogene Beobachtungen dokumentieren und die Aussage über die Reizantwort von einer nicht gemessenen zellulären Ursache unterscheiden.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can test a hypothesis about an observable organism stimulus response using a defined stimulus, suitable sham and scoring rule, safely and respecting species and nature protection, document original time-linked observations and distinguish the response claim from an unmeasured cellular cause.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB6: investigate observable organism stimulus responsiveness safely and protect organisms.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Defined stimulus, sham, scoring/time rule and separation from an unmeasured cellular cause make the response claim observable and bounded in DE/EN.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: The whole Mimosa design retains separate main/transfer plants, original N/C/U records, plant-level replication and null/uncertain outcomes. Its arithmetic example is constructed.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Gentle touch versus no touch asks for observation/comparison without asserting numerical response, pain, learning or a particular cellular mechanism.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Lebewesen auch im Freiland anhand beobachteter Merkmale und geeigneter Bestimmungsliteratur bestimmen, den Bestimmungsweg dokumentieren und bei unzureichenden Merkmalen eine begründete Gruppen- oder Unsicherheitsangabe beibehalten.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can identify organisms, including in the field, from observed traits and suitable identification literature, document the identification route and retain a justified group-level or uncertain assignment where traits are insufficient.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB7: use identification literature, including field identification.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Observation, suitable literature, documented route and a justified group/uncertainty result remain one identification outcome. Missing diagnostic traits do not license invented species names.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Lawn/pond observations and new specimens require fresh verified traits and a matching literature/key route. A supplied grouping key or taxon name does not replace that performance.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The meadow illustration is a schematic identification situation, not confirmed species inventory. Identification sensibly precedes community surveying; neither confers mastery of the other.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleDe: Lebensgemeinschaften und Standortfaktoren im Freiland charakterisieren
goalReviews.titleEn: Characterise communities and site factors in the field
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine hypothesengeleitete ökologische Freilanduntersuchung schonend planen und durchführen, Lebensgemeinschaften sowie abiotische Standortfaktoren qualitativ und quantitativ mit eigener Stichprobe dokumentieren und beobachtete Zusammenhänge von kausalen Aussagen unterscheiden.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can plan and carry out a careful hypothesis-driven ecological field investigation, document communities and abiotic site factors qualitatively and quantitatively using original sampling and distinguish observed associations from causal claims.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB7: hypothesis-led field characterisation of communities and abiotic factors qualitatively and quantitatively.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Sampling, community/site records and association-versus-causation limits define one field-survey outcome. Both languages preserve actual field work and original sampling.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Lawn, pond and new post-weather-change sampling require original field records. Cover, density, taxonomic groups and relative moisture index remain distinct; observation alone does not isolate one cause.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The full Native title and description wrap readably. The quadrat illustration is orienting. A separate 360px Runtime title/icon overlap is recorded as an open presentation REVISION, with no canonical wording change.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleDe: Standortbezogene Lebensraumeignung mit Feld- und Wirkungsdaten beurteilen
goalReviews.titleEn: Assess site-specific habitat suitability using field and effect data
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine sichere, art- und naturschutzgerechte ökologische Laboruntersuchung oder manipulative Freilanduntersuchung zur Wirkung eines Umweltfaktors tatsächlich durchführen und deren eigene Wirkungsdaten mit dokumentierten Freilandbedingungen verknüpfen, um eine art-, lebensstadien- und messgrößenbezogene Beurteilung eines Lebensraums mit Unsicherheit, Übertragungsgrenzen und gegebenenfalls offener Entscheidung zu begründen.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can actually conduct a safe, species- and nature-respecting ecological laboratory or manipulative field investigation of an environmental factor and combine its original effect data with documented field conditions to justify a species-,life-stage- and outcome-specific habitat judgement with uncertainty,transfer limits and,where necessary,an unresolved decision.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB7: actually conduct ecological laboratory/manipulative field testing and use effects for habitat-suitability assessment.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: The long description still identifies one integrated judgement: original effect data connected to documented field conditions. Species, life stage, outcome, uncertainty and possible non-decision constrain the claim in both languages.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Cress and duckweed cases require actual controlled effect data plus an evidence table connecting site conditions and transfer limits. Repeating 07bf alone does not establish the habitat judgement.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The whole Native page is readable. The explicitly schematic lizard/site picture establishes neither suitability, a single cause nor an executed effect test. Basic organism-requirements investigation is a defensible foundation.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleEn: Explain food preparation techniques biologically and chemically
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann alltagsrelevante Techniken zur Zubereitung und Veredelung von Lebensmitteln praktisch einsetzen und ihre biologischen sowie chemischen Grundlagen erklaeren.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can practically apply everyday techniques for preparing and refining food and explain their biological and chemical foundations.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB4: practically apply selected everyday food techniques and explain biological and chemical foundations.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Applying a technique and explaining its foundations form one source-backed practical competence. Neither language demands every suggested technique or an entire food-technology curriculum.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Whole dough and defined-starter milk cases require original manufacture and link gas retention or acid/protein behaviour to biology/chemistry. Appearance, pH or rise alone do not prove food safety.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The broad overview is orienting. Recipes, hygiene, controls and original execution must come from the full cases and chosen actual materials.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleDe: Arznei- und Koerperpflegemittel herstellen und chemisch erklaeren
goalReviews.titleEn: Produce and chemically explain pharmaceutical and personal-care products
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann ausgewaehlte Arznei- oder Koerperpflegemittel herstellen und die chemischen Grundlagen der Herstellung fachlich erklaeren.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can prepare selected pharmaceutical or personal-care products and explain the chemical foundations of their production.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB4: produce selected pharmaceutical OR personal-care products and explain manufacture.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: The description retains the source alternative and does not require both categories, drug synthesis, medical efficacy or skin-safety proof. DE/EN preserve the same practical explanatory outcome.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Whole cream/balm cases are valid personal-care alternatives. Manufacture and interface/phase reasoning do not establish shelf life, compatibility or a new chemical synthesis.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The oil-in-water emulsion is one illustration. Its warm-process picture is not the cold-process protocol; the selected actual recipe and supervision remain controlling.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleDe: Werk- und Baustoffe herstellen und Eigenschaften pruefen
goalReviews.titleEn: Produce construction and engineering materials and test properties
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Werk- und Baustoffe herstellen, deren Eigenschaften unter vergleichbaren Bedingungen untersuchen und daraus Einsatzmoeglichkeiten begruendet beurteilen.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can produce construction and engineering materials, test their properties under comparable conditions, and use the findings to justify possible applications.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB4: manufacture materials, compare properties under matched conditions and justify application.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Manufacture, comparable property testing and conditional use judgement form one material-evaluation outcome, assessable in both languages.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Whole plaster/film cases connect original preparation with setting, geometry and plasticiser effects. School fracture loads do not provide structural certification; bendability is not tensile strength.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Concrete is an orienting example, not a replacement for original plaster/film records. The successor system-combination goal requires its own assembled system and performance.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.titleDe: Werk- und Baustoffe zu funktionellen Systemen kombinieren
goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann ausgewaehlte Werk- und Baustoffe zu funktionellen Systemen kombinieren und moegliche Anwendungen in Alltag und Technik fachlich begruenden.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can combine selected construction and engineering materials into functional systems and justify possible applications in everyday life and technology.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB4: combine selected construction/engineering materials into functional systems and justify uses.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: Actual combination and application reasoning are distinct from producing/testing one material. DE/EN identify the same coherent system outcome.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Whole model-wall/filter cases expose component roles, interfaces and original comparative tests. Clarity is not potability/salt removal, and transient temperature is not full conductivity measurement.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: Load/material illustrations suggest coordinated component roles without prescribing a pupil bridge or granting structural approval. The material-testing prerequisite is coherent.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

goalReviews.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Verfahren zur Herstellung mikroskopischer Praeparate auswaehlen, Mikroorganismen, Gewebe, Zellen, Stoffe oder Materialien sicher mikroskopieren, charakteristische Eigenschaften identifizieren, beschriftete Zeichnungen erstellen und die Taetigkeit dokumentieren.
goalReviews.descriptionEn: The learner can select methods for preparing microscopic specimens, safely examine microorganisms, tissues, cells, substances, or materials microscopically, identify characteristic properties, create labelled drawings, and document the work.
goalReviews.sourceFidelity: LB5: select specimen preparation/microscopy, examine biological or material samples, document and draw observed structures.
goalReviews.wordingAndAssessability: The specimen types are alternatives within one microscopy workflow, not separate mandatory certifications. Both descriptions preserve selection, safe examination, characteristic observations, labelled drawing and documentation.
goalReviews.materialToGoalAndLimitations: Whole onion/starch cases require actual preparation/focusing and original drawings. Unseen nuclei, granule-to-cell identification and an uncalibrated scale must not be invented; a folded specimen or magnification change exposes the method limit.
goalReviews.figurePageAndRelations: The workflow illustration is a specimen/drawing example, not an observed onion/starch record or an independently calibrated learner drawing. Actual Native wording is complete and readable.
goalReviews.courseBoundary: Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

contextOnlyReviews.finding: New reverse links do not change label interpretation into full risk/disposal judgement. Four illustrated labels remain partial safety examples.
Risk assessment remains a shared practical foundation. Illustrated controls/checkmarks do not substitute for the particular material risk assessment.
The new preparation link uses molar mass in its equation/material balance. The water model does not replace limiting-reagent reasoning.
The new enzyme link distinguishes conceptual factor descriptions from actual controlled enzyme investigation. The pH picture is not catalase evidence.

contextOnlyReviews.currentTitleDe: Stoffe isolieren, reinigen und Ausbeute beurteilen
contextOnlyReviews.finding: Isolation/purification retains a distinct practical purity/yield outcome alongside separate analysis/preparation children. Those children do not silently complete it.

contextOnlyReviews.currentTitleDe: Chemische Informationen in geeignete Darstellungen überführen
contextOnlyReviews.finding: The actual page retains its source-comprehension prerequisite and separate representation outcome. It has no direct new BcP-child requirement; the diagram is not a learner-created product.
New reverse links support validity judgement in analysis/identification. The illustrative trend alone does not prove a sample identity or a new validity performance.
Added reverse links preserve documentation as a shared foundation. Synthetic table/graph values do not count as an original BcP practical record.
Added child links retain guided investigation as a foundation. Child-specific actual performance remains necessary; the tablet picture supplies neither their protocol nor data.

Global QA HOLD outside these 24 pages neither grants nor vetoes these finite decisions.
